brief: Create an original, warm, practical short conversation for US couples about healthy relationships. Choose a fresh topic and angle each run, and vary topics across runs. Draw from a broad mix: green flags and healthy habits, communication and listening, small everyday moments of care, dating and keeping the spark alive, marriage and partnership, resolving disagreements kindly, supporting each other through stress, love languages, quality time, and growing together. Keep content wholesome, realistic, and shareable, in warm natural American English. Avoid toxic drama, blame, and stereotyping; do not encourage manipulation or control; keep it general, not individualized counseling.
